selection: Mechanical key/title leakage exclusions, then SHA256(seed:query_id), without filtering on author history, retrieval success or model scores.
reason: The original 2018 graph leaves a seven-year gap to the reserved cohort. Use only pre-test 2024 evidence at inference, after model selection on the old graph. A predeclared 1000-query sample bounds CPU neural scoring cost; remaining eligible reserved records stay unscored.
model_selection: Validation nDCG@10, then MRR; cheaper model for exact metric ties. No test-based selection.
limits: In-slice temporal assessment with a changed inference snapshot, not an independent field test. Pretrained model overlap cannot be ruled out. Keep all eligible missing-history authors in denominators.
